# Wholesale Chef Knife

> Leading wholesale distributor of Japanese Damascus steel chef knives, knife blanks, and kitchen accessories from Yangjiang, Guangdong, specializing in VG-10 and AUS-10 steel with custom branding options.

Wholesale Chef Knife (WCK) is a kitchen knife manufacturer and distributor offering bulk orders of professional-grade Japanese chef knives, custom knife blanks, and cutting boards. The company serves restaurants, corporate clients, and knife enthusiasts with Damascus steel products and customization services including logo etching.
